page_title: NAP 0-0 COM | Napoli v Como 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) takes the corner kick, but Jean Butez reads it well and stops the effort.
87' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli).
87' The referee signals a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Rasmus Hojlund.
87' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
84' Assane Diao (Como) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
82' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Jayden Addai will be replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Morata trots off the pitch and is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Como).
78' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
77' Napoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' Here's the change. David Neres leaves the pitch and Noa Lang (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
72' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is yellow-carded.
72' Luca Zufferli interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Eljif Elmas (Napoli). Como have been awarded a free kick.
71' Today's match ends for Ivan Smolcic who will be replaced by Stefan Posch (Como).
71' Here is a change. Maxence Caqueret is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Da Cunha (Como).

70' Scott McTominay (Napoli) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
68' Assane Diao (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
67' Matteo Politano (Napoli) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
66' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's David Neres (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
64' The corner from David Neres (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.
63' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Ivan Smolcic (Como) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
59' The keeper makes a simple save after Matteo Politano (Napoli) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
58' Luca Zufferli blows the whistle, David Neres (Napoli) is penalised for a foul.
57' Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Jean Butez.

56' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
54' Cesc Fabregas is stunned as referee Luca Zufferli shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
54' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Nico Paz (Como) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
52' Jacobo Ramon (Como) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
48' What a beautiful long-range strike by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Antonio Conte gives a chance to Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) and Leonardo Spinazzola is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Luca Zufferli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Nico Paz (Como) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
45+1' The shot by Eljif Elmas (Napoli) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Jean Butez.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

43' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
42' The resulting corner from David Neres (Napoli) is cleared by the defence.

42' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' It's a yellow card for Ivan Smolcic (Como).

39' Ivan Smolcic (Como) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
37' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Billy Gilmour cannot continue after picking up an injury.
31' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' The referee blows his whistle as Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Como.
29' David Neres (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
27' Scott McTominay (Napoli) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Jean Butez is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
26' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates the direction of the penalty by Alvaro Morata (Como). He attempted to put the ball inside the right post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
26' Alvaro Morata (Como) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
25' Referee Luca Zufferli makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
25' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Napoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
22' Maxence Caqueret (Como) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
22' Nico Paz (Como) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) earns the yellow card.
21' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Luca Zufferli signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Como.
21' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Assane Diao (Como) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
16' Maximo Perrone (Como) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
16' Maximo Perrone (Como) brings an opponent down and Luca Zufferli interrupts the game. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
14' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Luca Zufferli signals a set piece. Como are awarded a free kick.
12' David Neres (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
10' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Marc Oliver Kempf suffers an injury and Diego Carlos (Como) comes on.
6' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

5' Chance! Maxence Caqueret (Como) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and makes a great save to deny him.

3' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) who sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
3' Nico Paz (Como) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Luca Zufferli stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Como, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Como will kick the game off.
Luca Zufferli will referee today's match.
